title: Stationary Bohmian superposition under amplitude and phase modulation
summary: In this work, we examine the problem of stationary superposition in the Bohmian amplitude phase formulation, where amplitude and phase obey coupled nonlinear equations and direct linear superposition is not generally preserved. Considering two near degenerate stationary branches, we derive a hierarchical reduction in which the mean amplitude satisfies an Ermakov Pinney equation, while the difference amplitude evolves through a forced Mathieu Hill type modulation induced by energy and stationary current differences. It is shown that energy coherence alone does not uniquely determine phase…
